name: Safe Repository Change
description: Make one bounded local repository change in an isolated Git worktree, then run controller-owned patch validation.

taskId.title: Task ID
taskId.description: Stable identifier used for the isolated branch name.

task.title: Requested change
task.description: Describe one bounded change that can be completed without external systems.

constraints.title: Constraints
constraints.description: List compatibility, scope, style or testing constraints.

stages.name: Understand
stages.description: Inspect the repository and translate the request into a bounded change plan.

stages.name: Change
stages.description: Edit only files required for the requested outcome inside the isolated worktree.

stages.name: Review
stages.description: Review the patch for scope, correctness and incomplete work before controller validation.
